title: Event envelope
description: Standard envelope for every cross-module event (contract §3.4.1, PLAN §4.3, D-ARC-02, D-CON-01, D-CON-09, D-CON-19). Each event schema in contracts/events/<module>/ composes this envelope with allOf, pins eventType, producer, aggregateType and dataClassification, and binds payload to its own payload schema. Fields are camelCase except the set-completeness fields, which keep the contract D4 names set_id, set_size and index.

eventId.description: Unique event id, UUIDv7 (contract §3.4.1). Consumers are idempotent on this id (plt.processed_event).

eventType.description: Catalogued event name, PascalCase past tense (e.g. PolicyBound). The registry name is <producer lower-case>.<eventType> (XMR-F-121).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version major.minor. Minor versions are additive only; a breaking change is a new major published in parallel.

producer.description: Producing module code (contract §3.6.1). Exactly one producer per event type.

aggregateType.description: Type of the aggregate whose order consumers depend on (R-100).

aggregateId.description: Ordering key: the stable id of the aggregate (contract partition key, D-ARC-02). Usually a UUID; some aggregates use a stable code (stamp, pack, rc_code, GLOBAL).

aggregateSequence.description: Per-aggregate sequence, starting at 1 and gap-free per (aggregateType, aggregateId). The dispatcher delivers events of one aggregate in this order.

occurredAt.description: Business time of the fact, RFC 3339 UTC.

recordedAt.description: Time the fact was committed with its outbox row, RFC 3339 UTC.

legalEntity.description: Legal entity code the fact belongs to (stamp per legal entity, D-ARC-01).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction where the contract envelope requires it (contract §3.4.1).

configurationHash.description: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) of the resolved configuration in force when the fact was produced (D-ARC-12). For MKT activation events it is the hash after the change.

businessKeys.description: Business lineage keys (D5, D-CON-01): named business ids such as quoteId, jobId, policyId, transactionId, chargeId, invoiceId, claimId, journalId. Journey lineage uses these, never correlationId.

correlationId.description: W3C trace-id (32 lower-case hex, not all zero) for technical tracing only (D-CON-01).

causationId.description: eventId of the event, or id of the command, that caused this event; null for an originating user or system action.

actor.description: Who caused the fact: user, service or AI agent id (contract §3.4.1).

aiInteractionId.description: AiInteractionRecord id when the fact came from an accepted AI suggestion (contract §3.4.1); null otherwise.

origin.description: LIVE for normal business, MIGRATION for converted business (contract §3.4.1, D-CON-09), REPLAY for events re-emitted by the replay command. MIG's own events are LIVE.

dataClassification.description: Highest personal-data class among the payload fields (P0 not personal, P1 personal, P2 personal-sensitive, P3 special category; contract §3.2.1, R-66). Each event schema pins this value.

set_id.description: Contract D4 set-completeness: id of the set of events a consumer must process as a whole (e.g. one out-of-sequence aggregate or one transaction's charge deltas). Name kept as in the contract (D-CON-19).

set_size.description: Contract D4: number of members in the set.

index.description: Contract D4: 1-based position of this event in its set (1..set_size).

payload.description: Event-specific payload. Its schema is the Payload definition of the event schema for eventType at schemaVersion.
